scores.evidence: The s3-diagram flowchart (図1) uses a TD layout with readable Japanese labels at 390 px (pages/mobile-jp-09.png). The two-column tables s2-table, s3-table, s4-table and pr-answer fit at 390 px with no sideways overflow (pages/mobile-jp-06.png, 10, 12-13, 27). One code line in pr-code is cut off at 390 px (pages/mobile-jp-22.png).

metrics.json reports textOnlyScreens [] for desktop and mobile. Every screen has a heading, definition table, figure, code, steps or a check. The desktop median is 39 characters per line, inside the 30-40 target (max 53). There are no walls of text: paragraphs are 2-4 lines on desktop (pages/desktop-jp-03.png, 07).

The lesson is Japanese-only, and every screen shows consistent Japanese with English glosses for terms (セッション（session）, サブエージェント（subagent）) and lang=ja. Contrast is fine throughout. The reader wraps a few lines inside words at 390 px, for example 見分/け in the objectives (pages/mobile-jp-01.png) and 圧/縮 in s2-table (pages/mobile-jp-06.png).

mustFix.issue: At 390 px the echo line of the practice terminal block is cut off at the right edge after '> CL'. Learners cannot see that the command writes CLAUDE.md, even though the next step says 'CLAUDE.mdは起動前に作ります'.
mustFix.fix: Shorten the line so it fits about 40 monospace characters, e.g. `echo '- titleは「練習：」で始める' > CLAUDE.md`. Or split it into two lines: a short comment `# ルールを1行書いたCLAUDE.mdを作る` followed by a shorter echo command.

reader: line breaks inside words at 390 px (見分/け in the objectives on pages/mobile-jp-01.png and pages/mobile-jp-33.png; 圧/縮 in s2-table on pages/mobile-jp-06.png). Consider BudouX or word-break: keep-all for Japanese.

Desktop charsPerLine max is 53, above the 30-40 target. The median of 39 is fine.
summary: The lessonHash in metrics.json matches the expected sha256:319f5a2007903c95. The hard-failure counts are all 0: overflowX false, consoleErrors 0, mermaidErrors 0, unknownBlocks 0, brokenImages 0. The layout is clean and well paced on mobile and desktop: the flowchart and two-column tables read well at 390 px, there are no text-only screens, and no screen shows personal data. One fix is needed: the echo line in pr-code is cut off at 390 px, which hides the CLAUDE.md target. Shorten or split that line.
